```{r load the library}
library(Matrix)
library(Seurat)
library(Signac)
library(patchwork)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(magrittr)
library(openxlsx) 
library(harmony)
library(clustree)
library(knitr)
set.seed(6)
```

```{r load seurat objects}
dropseq <- readRDS("objects/jh_dropseq/objects/sobj.merged.qc.RDS")
```

```{r sct}
# SCTransform
options(future.globals.maxSize= 891289600)
dropseq <- dropseq %>%
   NormalizeData() %>%
   FindVariableFeatures(selection.method = "vst", nfeatures=3000) %>%   
   ScaleData() %>%
   SCTransform(vars.to.regress = NULL)

# remove atac and macs2 assay 
atlas <- readRDS("output/objects/atlas.RDS")
atlas@assays$peaksMACS2 <- NULL
atlas@assays$ATAC <- NULL
```


```{r}
# prep dropseq data 
dropseq <- PrepSCTFindMarkers(dropseq)
```


```{r}
# find transfer anchors
DefaultAssay(dropseq) <- "SCT"
DefaultAssay(atlas) <- "SCT"
atlas.anchors <- FindTransferAnchors(reference = atlas, query = dropseq, dims = 1:50
                               , normalization.method = "SCT"
                               , reference.reduction = "pca")

atlas <- RunUMAP(atlas, reduction = "rna_harmony", assay = "SCT", dims = 1:50, reduction.name = 'umap.rna', reduction.key = 'rnaUMAP_',return.model = TRUE)
    
dropseq <- MapQuery(anchorset = atlas.anchors, reference = atlas, query = dropseq, refdata = atlas$Cell_Type, reference.reduction = "pca", reduction.model = "umap.rna")
dropseq$Cell_Type <- dropseq$predicted.id
dropseq$Cell_Type.score <- dropseq$predicted.id.score
dropseq <- MapQuery(anchorset = atlas.anchors, reference = atlas, query = dropseq, refdata = atlas$Subtype, reference.reduction = "pca", reduction.model = "umap.rna")
dropseq$Subtype <- dropseq$predicted.id
dropseq$Subtype.score <- dropseq$predicted.id.score
dropseq <- MapQuery(anchorset = atlas.anchors, reference = atlas, query = dropseq, refdata = atlas$dev.group, reference.reduction = "pca", reduction.model = "umap.rna")
dropseq$dev.group <- dropseq$predicted.id
dropseq$dev.group.score <- dropseq$predicted.id.score
saveRDS(dropseq, "output/objects/mapping/dropseq_map_to_ATLAS.rds")

```

## MS
```{r load seurat objects}
ms <- readRDS("objects/MS/objects/ms.rds")
```

```{r sct}
# SCTransform
options(future.globals.maxSize= 2508544921)
ms <- ms %>%
   NormalizeData() %>%
   FindVariableFeatures(selection.method = "vst", nfeatures=3000) %>%
   ScaleData() %>%
   SCTransform(vars.to.regress = NULL)
```


```{r}
ms <- PrepSCTFindMarkers(ms)
```


```{r}
DefaultAssay(ms) <- "SCT"
DefaultAssay(atlas) <- "SCT"
atlas.anchors <- FindTransferAnchors(reference = atlas, query = ms, dims = 1:50
                               , normalization.method = "SCT"
                               , reference.reduction = "pca")

saveRDS(atlas.anchors, "output/objects/mapping/ms.anchors.rds")
```


```{r}
atlas <- RunUMAP(atlas, reduction = "rna_harmony", assay = "SCT", dims = 1:50, reduction.name = 'umap.rna', reduction.key = 'rnaUMAP_',return.model = TRUE)

ms <- MapQuery(anchorset = atlas.anchors, reference = atlas, query = ms, refdata = atlas$Cell_Type, reference.reduction = "pca", reduction.model = "umap.rna")
ms$Cell_Type <- ms$predicted.id
ms$Cell_Type.score <- ms$predicted.id.score


ms <- MapQuery(anchorset = atlas.anchors, reference = atlas, query = ms, refdata = atlas$Subtype, reference.reduction = "pca", reduction.model = "umap.rna")

ms$Subtype <- ms$predicted.id
ms$Subtype.score <- ms$predicted.id.score


ms <- MapQuery(anchorset = atlas.anchors, reference = atlas, query = ms, refdata = atlas$dev.group, reference.reduction = "pca", reduction.model = "umap.rna")
ms$dev.group <- ms$predicted.id
ms$dev.group.score <- ms$predicted.id.score

saveRDS(ms, "output/objects/mapping/ms_map_to_ATLAS.rds")
```


# DMGs

```{r load seurat objects}
cancer <- readRDS("/igm/projects/HD-BAT_Wedemeyer/objects/cancer/cancer.rds")
```

```{r sct}

cancer@meta.data$DX[cancer@meta.data$sample_id == "JL12_T"] <- "DMG"

cancer@meta.data$Subgroup[cancer@meta.data$sample_id == "JL12_T"] <- "DMG"


cancer@meta.data$sample_name[cancer@meta.data$sample_id == "JL12_T"] <- "JL12_T"

cancer <- subset(cancer, Subgroup != "Normal")

cancer$Subgroup <- factor(cancer$Subgroup, levels = c("DMG", "G34-GBM", "e-GBM", "GBM", "pHGG", "RIG"))

cancer$sample_id <- cancer$sample_name

cancer <- subset(cancer, Subgroup == "DMG")

# SCTransform
cancer <- cancer %>%
   NormalizeData() %>%
   FindVariableFeatures(selection.method = "vst", nfeatures=3000) %>%   
   ScaleData() %>%
   SCTransform(vars.to.regress = NULL)

```


```{r prep sct}
# Prep SCT assay to find markers
cancer <- PrepSCTFindMarkers(cancer)
```

```{r find transfer anchors}
# Find transfer anchors
DefaultAssay(cancer) <- "SCT"
DefaultAssay(atlas) <- "SCT"
atlas.anchors <- FindTransferAnchors(reference = atlas, query = cancer, dims = 1:50
                               , normalization.method = "SCT"
                               , reference.reduction = "pca")
```

```{r map cancer to atlas}
# return umap model
atlas <- RunUMAP(atlas, reduction = "rna_harmony", assay = "SCT", dims = 1:50, reduction.name = 'umap.rna', reduction.key = 'rnaUMAP_',return.model = TRUE)
# map cancer to atlas
cancer <- MapQuery(anchorset = atlas.anchors, reference = atlas, query = cancer, refdata = atlas$Cell_Type, reference.reduction = "pca", reduction.model = "umap.rna")
cancer$Cell_Type <- cancer$predicted.id

saveRDS(cancer, "objects/mapping/dmg_map_to_ATLAS.rds")
```
